fact: FinDev Gateway says that since 2018 payments of the Burkina Faso Projet Filets Sociaux, the national social safety net system supported by the World Bank, have been made to mobile money accounts, after earlier cash payments, reaching over a million people by end 2022.

CARFO, the civil servants' pension fund, announced that from the fourth quarter of 2024 it will pay pensions and annuities by mobile money to pensioners now paid in cash or by cheque, with bank transfer as the alternative.

CNSS Burkina Faso signed a partnership contract with Orange Money on 31 May 2023 to pay pensions, family allowances and annuities to insured people's phones, progressively, for those now paid in cash at its counters.
CNSS says it moved many of its benefits from payment at counters to bank transfer.
